title: First Lessons: the Veil
introNarration: Mentor Mist sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of the Veil. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Mist.
completionNarration: Mist almost smiles. The Veil has your name, if not yet your silence.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of the Veil.
